title: Keeping fairness among strong desires

captions.emotions: Feel a fair share of involvement

meaning: Your union can handle strong desires more clearly when attention and fairness preserve freedom for both of you.
text: Within your shared rhythm, desire may be stronger than outward activity. In the physical position, the High Priestess leaves time to observe instead of treating an inner impulse as a settled decision. In energy, the Devil shows a motive that can bind: you want something so strongly that yielding or stopping becomes difficult. In emotions, Justice asks for an understandable relationship between choices and consequences. It feels calmer when you both see what a desire costs and know that participation is freely agreed, with both people considered.

Suppose you really want expensive concert tickets. You look at the seats, imagine the evening and gradually notice the wish pushing other plans aside. A conversation about spending gives those plans room again. **A shared desire remains shared while each of you can freely name its personal cost.** The eventual decision might be to buy, choose another section or decline. None of these outcomes measures your closeness, and neither of you needs to defend your feelings to make the choice legitimate.

The difficulty appears if an accurate calculation becomes a way to authorise something you find hard to refuse. You carefully divide the expense without discussing whether the purchase suits you both. Everything is equal on paper, while genuine agreement is weaker. An attachment acquires the appearance of fairness. An equal share cannot replace freedom to choose, especially when doubt already feels obstructive.
